strategyReview: What is working: the Polymarket YES-overpricing edge remains the strongest source of evidence, with PANEL_NO families (FIND-0065/0067/0069/0070) showing 63-81% win rates against a 50% base and positive holdout PnL, while live one-touch/manual IV-touch NO fades continue to pay on the contract. Weekend funding reversion is high win rate but low per-trade edge. What is failing: spot-directional momentum confirmations built on HYPE or listed-IV confirmation are near or below chance, and several funding-shadow families using a single absolute funding threshold are being triggered before the true extreme.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 scorable wins (36%) and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation is 4/19 (21%). Many triggers cluster around already-extended spots and fail the >2% exam; HYPE OI and listed-IV conditions are coincident risk-on signatures, not leading continuation signals.
failureClusters.recommendation: De-emphasize spot >2% exams for confirmation-based momentum. Convert contract-level edges to neutral contract P&L, and only retain spot momentum variants with a true regime-relative turn or flow-expansion filter.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS H-539 is 14/30 (47%), AAPL H-537 is 11/23 (48%), and MU H-535 is 6/18 (33%). Bare `funding < -10` entries frequently occur before the actual bottom, with funding continuing lower (e.g. CBRS -4.3% → -33.8%, -6.2% → -33.6%; MU 5.5% → -28.6%).
failureClusters.recommendation: Replace absolute thresholds with regime-relative lower-tail conditions plus a positive turn (e.g. percentile or z-score low and 1-day change > 0). This forces the setup to enter after an overshoot begins reversing, not as soon as funding is mildly negative.

failureClusters.theme: Wrong exam for contract premium fades
failureClusters.evidence: shadow_one_touch_high_edge_no_gold_heatmap_no H-534 has only 8/23 scorable wins and 7 burned unscorable, despite winning NO contract examples (NO GOLD below 4300 0.950→1.000). The primary prediction is still a GOLD spot decline >2%, while the edge is NO/YES touch premium decay.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author contract-edge variants as neutral contract P&L theses. Do not attach spot-move thresholds to one-touch/rich-NO premium fades; the scorer must grade the contract position, not the underlying.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: convert the gold cap-edge trade from a spot-decline call to a contract-premium fade. Require a high underlying-cap edge on GOLD, near-dated expiry, and tight spread; take the NO/SELL YES side and let premium decay.
newHypotheses.prediction: Buying NO / selling YES on GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as rich touch premium decays; contract P&L is positive, with no GOLD spot move claim.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: replace the bare absolute funding threshold with a regime-relative extreme and a turn. The original entered before the actual bottom; requiring the 7d percentile in the low tail and a positive 1-day change should only trigger after an overshoot begins reversing.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS funding continues normalizing upward and CBRS spot/perp rises >2% within 2 days after a regime-relative extreme and a positive 1-day turn.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: same mechanical change as CBRS — use AAPL funding's low 7d percentile and a positive 1-day turn instead of a single `aapl_hl_funding_ann < -10` reading.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL funding normalizes upward and AAPL spot/perp rises >2% within 2 days after a regime-relative extreme and a positive 1-day turn.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: use a z-score-based extreme and require a positive 1-day turn. The old `mu_hl_funding_ann < -10` fired too early and too frequently; this variant requires a genuine lower-tail reading already reversing.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU funding normalizes upward and MU spot/perp rises >2% within 2 days after a lower-tail extreme and a positive 1-day turn.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: sharpen the HYPE confirmation from near-stable OI to actually expanding OI and tighten the BTC breakout proximity. The original OI filter `> -2` admitted flat/declining OI and produced no genuine confirmation.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days when BTC is within 2% of its 7d high and HYPE OI expands >1% over 24h, confirming new risk-on flow rather than a late echo.

newHypotheses.description: Shadow FIND sibling for the one-touch NO edge on BTC: moderate 3-8pt sell-YES edge plus tight spread. The family has strong in-sample BTC premium fade but existing variants often mix assets/expiry; this isolates BTC and a practical spread bound.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / buying NO on BTC one-touch contracts with moderate 3-8pt model edge and tight spread is profitable over 3 days as overpriced touch premium decays.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-539 has 14/30 scorable wins (47%) under funding_normalize_up. The bare `cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10` trigger enters before the actual extreme; multiple losses show funding continuing from -4.3% to -33.8% and -6.2% to -33.6%, so the setup is catching ordinary negative prints, not reversion-ready extremes.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% is a sufficient timing trigger for a >2% CBRS spot move within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The HYPE-confirmed BTC continuation family has 9/25 scorable wins (36%). The `hype_hl_oi_change_pct_24h > -2` filter permits flat or falling OI, so it mostly confirms already-extended risk-on conditions; most entries fail to reach +2% and the few wins are concentrated in one or two broad up days.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-534 is still being graded partly as a spot-decline call: 8/23 scorable wins and 7 tests burned unscorable. The winning examples are contract NO appreciations (e.g. NO GOLD below 4300 0.950→1.000), not GOLD spot declining >2%, so the primary prediction is mismatched to the actual edge.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: The gold one-touch high-edge NO signal pays via a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-537 shows 11/23 scorable wins (48%). The single-threshold `aapl_hl_funding_ann < -10` entry produces losses when funding is already near neutral (5.5%) and gives back gains; it lacks a true extreme or turn filter.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single AAPL funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-535 has 6/18 scorable wins (33%). The same single-threshold pattern on MU often triggers at or near 5.5% and then funding continues to fall to -28.6%; signal frequency is not the problem, it is that the condition is not a reversion extreme.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% rapidly normalizes and produces >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation has 4/19 scorable wins (21%). Spot above 24h SMA plus near 7d high and rising 30d IV is a coincident rally signature, not a continuation signal; tests repeatedly fail the +2% exam and some variants appear to have been enforced in the wrong direction.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC spot momentum confirmed by rising listed option IV reliably leads to further >2% spot gains within 3-7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is that the NO/YES-overpricing edge remains the house edge, but several tests are still being burned by contract-vs-spot mismatches. The gold one-touch cap-edge family (H-534) must be permanently moved to neutral contract P&L, not spot decline; otherwise it will continue to generate unscorable tests. Funding shadow families using a single absolute threshold like `funding < -10` are near chance and need regime-relative extremes plus a turn filter. Momentum confirmation families (HYPE echo, listed IV) are weak and should not be counted as independent confirmation; their OI conditions are too permissive. I did not adjust risk parameters because the current live P&L evidence does not clearly favor a stop/target change, and the main fixing needed is hypothesis re-authoring rather than risk-shape tuning. Existing active PANEL hypoths from FIND-0065/0067/0069/0070 already cover many liquidity/spread siblings, so I avoided re-authoring low-confidence panel duplicates tonight and focused on refinements to failing setups plus one distinct BTC one-touch sibling from FIND-0055.
